title.rendered: Cisco Spring Internship 2027: ASIC Engineer Intern for Graduates, Apply Now

content.rendered:
Cisco Spring Internship 2027 for ASIC Engineer Intern is open in Bangalore (Hybrid) for 2027 graduates. Check tracks, eligibility, and apply online today.

New Delhi: Cisco has officially opened online applications for the ASIC Engineer – Spring Internship based in Bangalore, India. Listed under Cisco’s flagship Silicon One hardware engineering division (Job ID: 2032859), this hybrid internship invites 2027 graduating students to work on next-generation networking silicon and AI-era hardware platforms.

For Indian engineering students specializing in VLSI, electronics, computer architecture, or semiconductor design, this Cisco Spring Internship 2027 offers hands-on exposure to full product development—from chip design to silicon qualification. Interested candidates must submit their applications through the official Cisco Careers portal before interview slots fill up.

About Cisco and the Silicon One Team

Cisco is a global leader in enterprise networking, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity. Inside Cisco’s hardware engineering organization, the Silicon One team builds unified, high-performance networking silicon and electro-photonic platforms that power Cisco’s core switching, routing, and wireless systems worldwide.

Joining the Silicon One team as a Spring Intern is a rare opportunity for undergraduate and postgraduate hardware enthusiasts. Because the team manages end-to-end chip development—from architecture and RTL design to physical sign-off and production—interns collaborate directly with senior semiconductor architects on real commercial tape-outs.

Cisco Spring Internship 2027: Key Highlights

Role and Responsbility of Cisco Spring Internship 2027

According to the official Cisco Careers listing, the ASIC Engineer – Spring Internship spans multiple specialized semiconductor domains. Depending on your technical background and interview evaluation, interns contribute to one of three core tracks:

1. ASIC Analog & Mixed-Signal Design

  • Participate in analog and mixed-signal circuit design for next-generation silicon photonics integrated circuits supporting 100G, 200G, and 400G per Lambda solutions.
  • Work on high-speed datapath blocks including photonics modulator drivers, serializers, Phase-Locked Loops (PLLs), Transimpedance Amplifiers (TIAs), and control loops while optimizing power, performance, testability, and area.

2. Physical Design (Backend RTL-to-GDSII)

  • Contribute to state-of-the-art networking ASICs and electro-photonic engines built on advanced process nodes (sub-5nm, 3nm, and TSMC 2nm N2P).
  • Experience the complete backend RTL-to-GDSII implementation flow, including timing closure, placement constraints, static and dynamic IR-drop analysis, electromigration (EM) sign-off, and Power-Performance-Area (PPA) optimization.

3. ASIC Design & Verification (DV)

  • Build constrained-random verification environments and SystemVerilog Real Number Models (SV-RNM) to validate electrical and optical control logic, auto-deskew FSMs, and Sigma-Delta thermal tuning engines.
  • Architect reusable UVM (Universal Verification Methodology) testbench components—such as agents, scoreboards, checkers, and sequencers—using SystemVerilog.

Eligibility Criteria for Cisco Spring Internship 2027

Before applying on Cisco Careers, verify that you meet the mandatory academic and technical criteria specified in the official notice:

Educational & Batch Requirement

  • Eligible Graduating Batch: Strictly open to 2027 graduates only.
  • Academic Degree: Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), VLSI Design, Computer Engineering, or a closely related hardware discipline.

Technical & Soft Skills

  • Core Fundamentals: Solid grasp of digital logic design, analog design fundamentals, semiconductor physics, and analytical problem-solving.
  • Hardware Languages & Tools: Familiarity with Verilog, SystemVerilog, UVM, SPICE simulations, or scripting (Python/Perl/TCL) depending on your target track.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively in fast-paced global engineering teams.

Age Limit and Vacancy Count

  • Age Limit: Cisco has not specified any minimum or maximum age limit in the official job posting.
  • Number of Seats: Cisco does not publicly disclose exact internship seat numbers; positions are filled on a rolling review basis.

Stipend and Internship Benefits

Cisco has not officially disclosed the exact monthly stipend on the public job listing. Compensation and relocation details are communicated directly to shortlisted candidates during the offer stage.

Selected interns in Bangalore receive valuable professional benefits:

  • Paid Semiconductor Internship: Competitive monthly stipend aligned with Cisco India’s engineering internship standards.
  • Hybrid Work Flexibility: Balance in-lab hardware collaboration in Bangalore with flexible hybrid work schedules.
  • Cutting-Edge Node Exposure: Hands-on experience working on sub-5nm/2nm silicon technologies and high-speed optical networking chips.
  • Full-Time Conversion Potential: High-performing Spring interns are frequently evaluated for full-time Graduate Technical Engineer / ASIC Engineer roles upon graduation in 2027.

How to Apply for Cisco Spring Internship 2027 (Step-by-Step)

Follow these exact steps to apply through the official Cisco Careers portal:

  1. Visit the Official Job Page: Open the verified Cisco Careers ASIC Engineer – Spring Internship Portal.
  2. Click “Apply”: Select the Apply button on the job description page (Job ID: 2032859).
  3. Create or Sign In to Your Account: Log in to Cisco’s Workday candidate portal using your email address.
  4. Upload Your Resume & Academic Details: Attach your updated technical resume and verify your expected graduation date in 2027.
  5. Review and Submit: Double-check all details and submit your application. Save your confirmation email for tracking interview updates.

1. Who is eligible for the Cisco ASIC Engineer Spring Internship 2027?

This internship is strictly open to 2027 graduating students pursuing an engineering degree with strong fundamentals in analog design, digital logic, physical design, or ASIC verification.

2. Where is the Cisco Spring Internship 2027 located and what is the work mode?

The role is based in Bangalore, Karnataka, India, and operates in a Hybrid work mode.

3. Which team at Cisco is hiring for this ASIC Engineer internship?

The hiring is for Cisco’s Silicon One engineering team, which develops high-performance networking silicon and electro-photonic hardware platforms.

4. What technical skills are required for the Cisco ASIC Engineer Intern role?

Depending on the track, candidates should have solid fundamentals in analog/mixed-signal circuits, backend RTL-to-GDSII physical design, or SystemVerilog and UVM verification.

5. Is the stipend disclosed in the official Cisco internship notification?

No, Cisco has not publicly disclosed the exact stipend amount on the official careers portal. Compensation details are shared with shortlisted candidates during the offer stage.

6. Does Cisco charge any application fee for this internship?

No. Applying through the official Cisco Careers website is 100% free.
